latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Video Editing with Italiano.

- Edit raw video footage into Italian-style videos with AI, supporting captions and localized effects.
- Accepts MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM uploads up to 500MB and exports 1080p MP4 in 1–2 minutes.
- Automatic cloud-based processing with credits system and session management.
- Supports quick editing, batch processing, iterative workflows, and preview summaries.
- Guides users through authentication and setup for a seamless first-time experience.
